spec.description: Artist Albums: collect iconic bodies of work from the world's best artists — photographers, painters, sculptors, printmakers, any medium. Browse, search, daily discovery, research-seeded external albums with rich image pools from Wikimedia Commons + MET + Smithsonian + Europeana, and curated personal collections — a first-class Cortex citizen alongside books and movies.

tools.label: Browse Photo Albums
tools.description: Browse curated photo albums (external photographers + personal themed collections). Supports tabs (all/external/personal), filtering by photographer/style/theme, search, sort, and pagination.

style.description: Filter by style (street, documentary, portrait, etc.)

query.description: Search by title, photographer, or description

tools.label: Search Photo Albums
tools.description: Search curated photo albums by title, photographer, description, or theme.

tools.label: Seed External Album
tools.description: Research and add an artist's body of work to your library. Works for any medium — photography, painting, sculpture, printmaking, drawing, digital. Takes an artist name and optional album/series title; uses Wikipedia + Open Library + Wikimedia Commons + MET + Smithsonian + Europeana + web search + LLM synthesis to gather bio, signature works with real museum images, style, and cover. Writes to cache + Cortex page.

photographer.description: Artist name (e.g., 'Henri Cartier-Bresson', 'Vincent van Gogh', 'Yayoi Kusama', '森山大道'). Field name is 'photographer' for legacy reasons but any artist works.

albumTitle.description: Album, series, or body of work title (e.g., 'The Decisive Moment', 'Sunflowers'). Optional — if omitted, LLM picks the artist's most iconic work.

style.description: Optional style/movement hint (street, documentary, portrait, landscape, fine-art, impressionism, surrealism, cubism, abstract-expressionism, minimalism, pop-art, etc.)

refreshEntityId.description: Re-seed an existing album in place. Pass the album's entityId (e.g., 'research:photo-album:farewell-photography-shashin-yo-sayonara') to refresh its data without creating a duplicate.

tools.label: Curate Personal Album
tools.description: Create a themed album from your own photos. Takes a title, optional theme, and an array of photo entity IDs or file paths. Writes a personal album to cache + Cortex page.

theme.description: Optional theme (street, portrait, travel, family, nature, abstract, etc.)

photoEntityIds.description: Array of photos:photo:* entity IDs (from your photo library)

photoPaths.description: Array of photo file paths (alternative to entity IDs)

tools.label: Rate / Save Album
tools.description: Record user interaction with an album (save, rate, dismiss, favorite). Builds the taste profile that feeds daily discovery.

tools.label: Daily Album Discovery
tools.description: Today's photo-album discovery picks — day-of-week themes (Documentary / Street / Portrait / Fashion / Landscape / Fine Art / Photojournalism). Pulls photographer candidates from Wikipedia + Open Library + web search, curated by LLM against your taste profile. Cached per day.

refresh.description: Force refresh even if cached (default: false)

theme.description: Override theme (street, documentary, portrait, fashion, landscape, fine-art, photojournalism)

tools.label: Expand Album (Deep Research)
tools.description: Exhaustively pull additional works for an existing album from ALL available sources — Wikimedia Commons (categories + search), MET, Smithsonian, Europeana, Art Institute of Chicago. Dedupes by image URL, scores by metadata quality, appends to the album's plates, capped at 100 works total.

cap.description: Maximum total plates in the album after expansion (default: 100, max: 100)

tools.label: Update Cortex from Cache
tools.description: Rebuild the entity index and Cortex pages from the photo-albums cache. Run after manual cache edits or entity-index drift.
